descriptions.en:
<Bright>Adaptor </>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</> Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @Curve.PoisonDurationAP@ seconds.

<dim>Adaptor </>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: Heavily slows the target.</>

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Purple Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Every @Curve.TraitTimer@ seconds, Gromp gains</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitTimedAP*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Ability Power.</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Adaptateur </>%i:scaleAP%<Bright> :</> le Gromp crache une bulle nocive sur la cible actuelle qui explose au contact du premier ennemi touché, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques. Les ennemis situés dans un rayon de 1 hexagone autour de l'explosion subissent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques en @Curve.PoisonDurationAP@ sec.

<dim>Adaptateur </>%i:scaleAD%<dim> : le Gromp ralentit fortement la cible.</>

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff violet :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">toutes les @Curve.TraitTimer@ sec, le Gromp gagne</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitTimedAP*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> de puissance.</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>적응가 </>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</> 현재 대상에게 독성 방울을 뿜어냅니다. 독성 방울은 처음 적에게 적중하면 폭발해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 폭발 반경 1칸 내 적은 @Curve.PoisonDurationAP@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입습니다.

<dim>적응가 </>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: 대상을 크게 둔화시킵니다.</>

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">퍼플 버프:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitTimer@초마다 심술두꺼비가 주문력을</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitTimedAP*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">얻습니다.</>

descriptions.en:
Leap to the lowest Health enemy within @Curve.LeapHexRadius@ Hexes and deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. The next @Curve.NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks gain @Curve.EmpowerAspd.PercentMinusOne@% Attack Speed and deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% bonus physical damage.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Grey Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Gain Precision and </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitBaseCrit*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Critical Strike Chance, increased up to @Curve.TraitBonusCrit*100@% based on missing Health.</>
descriptions.fr:
Le Lycan bondit vers l'ennemi ayant le moins de PV dans un rayon de @Curve.LeapHexRadius@ hexagones et inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques. Ses @Curve.NumEmpoweredAttacks@ prochaines attaques gagnent @Curve.EmpowerAspd.PercentMinusOne@% de vitesse d'attaque et infligent @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques bonus.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff gris :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> le Lycan gagne Précision et </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitBaseCrit*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">de chances de coup critique, augmentées jusqu'à @Curve.TraitBonusCrit*100@% en fonction de ses PV manquants.</>
descriptions.ko:
@Curve.LeapHexRadius@칸 내 체력이 가장 낮은 적에게 도약해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 다음 기본 공격 @Curve.NumEmpoweredAttacks@회 동안 공격 속도를 @Curve.EmpowerAspd.PercentMinusOne@% 얻고 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%의 추가 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">그레이 버프:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">어스름늑대가 정밀 및 치명타 확률을 </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitBaseCrit*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">얻습니다. 치명타 확률은 잃은 체력에 비례해 @Curve.TraitBonusCrit*100@%까지 증가합니다.</>

descriptions.en:
Begin consuming @Curve.PercentManaPerSecond*100@% max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by @Curve.MRReduction@.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="Bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Teal Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Gain </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitManaRegenTooltip@</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Mana Regen for every @Curve.TraitChannelSecondsTooltip@ seconds channeled.</>
descriptions.fr:
Consomme @Curve.PercentManaPerSecond*100@% de mana max par seconde pour canaliser un rayon sur la cible. Chaque seconde pendant l'incantation, inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques à la cible et réduit sa résistance magique de @Curve.MRReduction@.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="Bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff turquoise :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">gagne </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitManaRegenTooltip@</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> de régénération de mana toutes les @Curve.TraitChannelSecondsTooltip@ sec de canalisation.</>
descriptions.ko:
매초 최대 마나의 @Curve.PercentManaPerSecond*100@%를 소모하며 정신을 집중해 대상에게 레이저를 발사합니다. 스킬을 사용하는 동안 매초 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히고 대상의 마법 저항력을 @Curve.MRReduction@ 감소시킵니다.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="Bright" inactiveStyle="dim">청록색 버프:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">정신 집중 @Curve.TraitChannelSecondsTooltip@초마다 마나 재생을 </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitManaRegenTooltip@</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">얻습니다.</>

descriptions.en:
Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and applying @Curve.WoundLevel@% <Keyword>Wound</> and @Curve.BurnAmount@% <Keyword>Burn</> for @Curve.WoundDuration@ seconds.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Scarlet Buff:</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> Cinderling gains</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitADOnCast*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Attack Damage each cast.</>

<rules>Wound: Reduces healing received.</>
<rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.</>
descriptions.fr:
Le Rougelin lance cinq feuilles acérées sur sa cible actuelle, infligeant un total de @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques et appliquant @Curve.WoundLevel@ % d'<Keyword>hémorragie</> et @Curve.BurnAmount@ % de <Keyword>brûlure</> pendant @Curve.WoundDuration@ sec.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff écarlate :</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> le Rougelin gagne</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitADOnCast*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> de dégâts d'attaque chaque fois qu'il lance sa compétence.</>

<rules>Hémorragie : réduit les soins reçus.</>
<rules>Brûlure : inflige chaque seconde des dégâts bruts équivalents à un pourcentage des PV max de la cible.</>
descriptions.ko:
날카로운 잎사귀 5개를 소환해 현재 대상에게 날려 총 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입히고 @Curve.WoundDuration@초 동안 @Curve.WoundLevel@% <Keyword>상처</> 및 @Curve.BurnAmount@% <Keyword>화상</>을 적용합니다.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">진홍색 버프:</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> 스킬을 사용할 때마다 불타는 묘목이 공격력을</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitADOnCast*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">얻습니다.</>

<rules>상처: 체력 회복량 감소</>
<rules>화상: 매초 대상 최대 체력의 일정 비율만큼 고정 피해</>

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to all adjacent enemies.

<bright>Active:</> Burrow underground, gaining @Curve.BurrowDurability*100@% Durability for @Curve.BurrowDuration@ seconds and healing @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% over the duration. 

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Green Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">When allies fall below @Curve.TraitHealthThreshold*100@% Health, they restore </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitPercentHeal*100@%</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> max Health.</>
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> les attaques sont remplacées par une danse qui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques à tous les ennemis adjacents.

<bright>Active :</> le Carapateur s'enterre pour gagner @Curve.BurrowDurability*100@% de durabilité pendant @Curve.BurrowDuration@ sec et se soigne de @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV sur cette durée.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff vert :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">les alliés qui passent sous @Curve.TraitHealthThreshold*100@% de PV récupèrent </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitPercentHeal*100@%</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> de leurs PV max.</>
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 기본 공격이 춤으로 대체되어 인접한 모든 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> 지하로 파고들어 @Curve.BurrowDuration@초 동안 내구력을 @Curve.BurrowDurability*100@% 얻고 지속시간에 걸쳐 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 체력을 회복합니다.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">그린 버프:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">아군 체력이 @Curve.TraitHealthThreshold*100@% 아래로 떨어지면 최대 체력의 </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitPercentHeal*100@%</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">만큼 체력을 회복합니다.</>

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> On death, split into two Kruglettes with @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them.

<Bright>Active:</> Gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth% damage.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Slate Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for @Curve.TraitShieldHealth*100@% max Health.</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> à sa mort, le Krug se divise en deux Krugos ayant @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% PV qui provoquent immédiatement les ennemis pour les forcer à les attaquer.

<Bright>Active :</> le Krug gagne @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% PV max, puis roule vers la cible, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth% pts de dégâts.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff ardoise :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">à sa mort, le Krug et les Krugos confèrent un bouclier aux alliés de @Curve.TraitShieldHealth*100@% des PV max.</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 사망 시 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%의 체력을 가진 꼬마 돌거북 두 마리로 분열하고 즉시 도발하여 적이 자신을 공격하도록 합니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> 최대 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% 얻고 대상에게 굴러가 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%의 피해를 입힙니다.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">진회색 버프:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">사망 시 돌거북과 꼬마 돌거북이 아군에게 최대 체력의 @Curve.TraitShieldHealth*100@%만큼 보호막을 부여합니다.</>

descriptions.en:
Gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Shield for @Curve.ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, and are <keyword>Mana Reaved</> for @Curve.ManaReaveFlat@.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Blue Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitAlliesManaRegen@</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Mana Regen.</>

<rules>Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.</>
descriptions.fr:
La Sentinelle gagne un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% PV pendant @Curve.ShieldDuration@ sec. Elle frappe le sol, envoyant une fissure en direction du plus grand nombre d'ennemis. Les ennemis touchés par la fissure sont brièvement projetés en l'air, subissent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques et une <keyword>inflation du mana</> de @Curve.ManaReaveFlat@.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff bleu :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">chaque fois que la Sentinelle lance une compétence, les alliés gagnent</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitAlliesManaRegen@</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> de régénération de mana.</>

<rules>Inflation du mana : augmente le coût en mana de la prochaine compétence.</>

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.

<bright>Active:</> Gain @Curve.FrenzyADPercent*100@% Attack Damage for @Curve.Duration@ seconds. During this time ignore @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% Armor.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Red Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Attacks @Curve.BurnAmount@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="Keyword" inactiveStyle="dim">Burn</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">enemies and heal Brambleback for</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitMaxHealthHeal*100@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">max Health.</>
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> lorsque sa cible meurt, le Roncier bondit vers sa nouvelle cible, lui infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques.

<bright>Active :</> il gagne @Curve.FrenzyADPercent*100@% de dégâts d'attaque pendant @Curve.Duration@ sec. Pendant ce délai, il ignore @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% de l'armure.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff rouge :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">les attaques infligent @Curve.BurnAmount@ %</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="Keyword" inactiveStyle="dim">de brûlure</> aux <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">ennemis et soignent le Roncier de</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitMaxHealthHeal*100@%</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> des PV max.</>
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 대상이 사망하면 다음 대상에게 도약해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> @Curve.Duration@초 동안 공격력을 @Curve.FrenzyADPercent*100@% 얻습니다. 지속시간 동안 방어력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% 무시합니다.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">레드 버프:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">기본 공격 시 적에게 @Curve.BurnAmount@%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="Keyword" inactiveStyle="dim">화상</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">을 적용하고 붉은 덩굴정령이 최대 체력의</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.TraitMaxHealthHeal*100@%</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">만큼 체력을 회복합니다.</>

descriptions.en: Gain @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% Attack Speed for the next @Curve.NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage and reduce Armor by @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%.
descriptions.fr: Xayah gagne @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% de vitesse d'attaque pendant @Curve.NumAttacks@ attaques. Ces attaques sont remplacées par des plumes qui infligent @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques et réduisent l'armure de @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%.
descriptions.ko: 다음 기본 공격 @Curve.NumAttacks@회 동안 공격 속도를 @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% 얻습니다. 이 기본 공격은 깃털로 대체되며 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입히고 방어력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 감소시킵니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Active:</> Gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @Curve.ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a cone. 

<Bright>Quest:</> Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, doubled at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power. <Rules>(Forge Power: </>@TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@<Rules> / </>@TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Active :</> Ornn gagne un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV pendant @Curve.ShieldDuration@ sec et inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques aux ennemis dans un cône.

<Bright>Quête :</> à chaque combat contre un joueur, Ornn stocke les dégâts bloqués sous forme de Pouvoir de la forge. À 3 étoiles, le montant est doublé. Vous gagnez une Enclume à artefacts chaque fois que le Pouvoir de la forge d'Ornn augmente suffisamment. <Rules>(Pouvoir de la forge : </>@TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@<Rules>/</>@TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>사용 시:</> @Curve.ShieldDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 보호막을 얻고 반경 원뿔 범위 내 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

<Bright>퀘스트:</> 플레이어 대상 전투마다 오른이 막은 피해량을 대장간의 힘으로 저장합니다. 3성일 경우 두 배로 적용됩니다. 대장간의 힘을 충분히 모을 때마다 유물 모루 1개를 획득합니다. <Rules>(대장간의 힘: </>@TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@<Rules>/</>@TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</>

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Adaptor </>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</> Gain @Curve.BonusAttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% Attack Speed for the next @Curve.NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.

<dim>Adaptor </>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Adaptateur </>%i:scaleAP%<Bright> :</> Nidalee gagne @Curve.BonusAttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% de vitesse d'attaque pour les @Curve.NumEmpoweredAttacks@ prochaines attaques. Ces attaques sont remplacées par des javelots qui infligent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques. La 3e attaque cible à la place l'ennemi le plus éloigné ayant le moins d'objets et inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques.

<dim>Adaptateur </>%i:scaleAD%<dim> : Nidalee se transforme en couguar (assassin de mêlée) qui griffe les ennemis.</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>적응가 </>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</> 다음 기본 공격 @Curve.NumEmpoweredAttacks@회 동안 공격 속도를 @Curve.BonusAttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% 얻습니다. 이 기본 공격이 투창으로 대체되고 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 3번째 기본 공격은 대신 아이템을 가장 적게 장착한 가장 멀리 있는 적을 대상으로 지정해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

<dim>적응가 </>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: 적을 휩쓰는 근접 쿠거 암살자로 변신합니다.</>

descriptions.en: Gain @Curve.Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the @Curve.NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @Curve.StunDuration@ seconds.
descriptions.fr: Hecarim gagne @Curve.Resists@ d'armure et de résistance magique pendant 3 secondes et récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV pendant la durée. Il lance des cavaliers fantomatiques sur les @Curve.NumEnemies@ ennemis les plus proches, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques et les étourdissant pendant @Curve.StunDuration@ sec.
descriptions.ko: 3초 동안 방어력 및 마법 저항력을 @Curve.Resists@ 얻고 지속시간에 걸쳐 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 체력을 회복합니다. 가장 가까운 적 @Curve.NumEnemies@명에게 유령 기수를 보내 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히고 @Curve.StunDuration@초 동안 기절시킵니다.

descriptions.en:
Blink away from the current target, deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them, and gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. 

Every 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Nature's Wrath and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% for each enemy it passes through (minimum @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@%).
descriptions.fr:
Ezreal se téléporte loin de sa cible actuelle, lui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques et gagne @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% de vitesse d'attaque.

Chaque 4e activation consomme la vitesse d'attaque conférée par Courroux de la nature et tire une décharge à travers le plus gros groupe d'ennemis, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques, réduits de @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% pour chaque ennemi traversé (minimum @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@%).
descriptions.ko:
현재 대상에게서 순간적으로 멀어진 다음, 대상에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입히고 공격 속도를 @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% 얻습니다.

스킬을 4회 사용할 때마다 자연의 분노로 얻은 공격 속도를 소모하여 가장 큰 무리를 관통하는 파동을 발사합니다. 파동은 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입히며, 관통한 적 하나당 피해량이 @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% 감소합니다. (최소 @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@%)

descriptions.en: Gain @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% Attack Speed and summon @Curve.SoldiersToSpawn@ soldiers for the next @Curve.NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per attack.
descriptions.fr: Azir gagne @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% de vitesse d'attaque et invoque @Curve.SoldiersToSpawn@ soldats lors de ses @Curve.NumAttacks@ prochaines attaques. Ces attaques sont remplacées par des ordres qui ordonnent à chaque soldat d'infliger @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques par attaque.
descriptions.ko: 공격 속도를 @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% 얻고 다음 @Curve.NumAttacks@번의 기본 공격 동안 병사 @Curve.SoldiersToSpawn@명을 소환합니다. 이 기본 공격은 명령으로 대체되어 기본 공격마다 병사가 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> Restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% Health each second, tripled for @Curve.SpellMultiplierDuration@ seconds after casting.

<bright>Active:</> Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for @Curve.KnockupDuration@ second and dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them.
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> Rek'Sai récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% PV par seconde. Les soins sont triplés pendant @Curve.SpellMultiplierDuration@ sec après le lancement.

<bright>Active :</> Rek'Sai surgit hors du sol, étourdissant les ennemis adjacents pendant @Curve.KnockupDuration@ sec et leur infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques.
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 매초 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth%의 체력을 회복합니다. 스킬 사용 후 @Curve.SpellMultiplierDuration@초 동안 체력 회복량이 세 배로 증가합니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> 땅에서 튀어나와 인접한 적을 @Curve.KnockupDuration@초 동안 기절시키고 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, increased to @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% if they're below @Curve.HPThreshold*100@% max Health.

If they die, permanently gain @Curve.APOnKill@% Ability Power.

Current bonus: @TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@% %i:scaleAP%
descriptions.fr:
Veigar lance une gigantesque déflagration sur la cible, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques, augmentés à @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% si la cible possède moins de @Curve.HPThreshold*100@% de PV max.

Si la cible meurt, Veigar gagne définitivement @Curve.APOnKill@ % de puissance.

Bonus actuel : @TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@ % %i:scaleAP%
descriptions.ko:
대상에게 거대한 폭발을 일으켜 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 대상의 체력이 최대 체력 @Curve.HPThreshold*100@% 아래일 경우 피해량이 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 피해로 증가합니다.

대상이 사망하면 영구적으로 주문력을 @Curve.APOnKill@% 얻습니다.

현재 추가 효과: @TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@% %i:scaleAP%

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> After every @Curve.DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% magic damage. On death, @Curve.SaplingsOnDeath@ saplings jump out.

<Bright>Active:</> Deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% magic damage to target and restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% + @Curve.ActiveMissingHealthHeal*100@% missing Health.
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> lorsque Maokai bloque @Curve.DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ pts de dégâts, il lance un arbrisseau vers un ennemi proche qui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% pts de dégâts magiques. Lorsque Maokai meurt, @Curve.SaplingsOnDeath@ arbrisseaux jaillissent.

<Bright>Active :</> Maokai inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% pts de dégâts magiques à sa cible et récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% + @Curve.ActiveMissingHealthHeal*100@% de ses PV manquants.
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> @Curve.DamageMitigatedPerSapling@의 피해를 막을 때마다 묘목이 주변 적에게 도약해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 사망 시 묘목 @Curve.SaplingsOnDeath@개가 튀어나옵니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> 대상에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth%의 마법 피해를 입히고 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%+잃은 체력의 @Curve.ActiveMissingHealthHeal*100@%만큼 체력을 회복합니다.

descriptions.en: Gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @Curve.ShieldDuration@ seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% magic damage to enemies within @Curve.AoEHexRange@ hexes.
descriptions.fr: Malphite gagne un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV pendant @Curve.ShieldDuration@ sec et se pétrifie. Lorsque le bouclier se brise, il libère une vague d'énergie noire, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% pts de dégâts magiques aux ennemis situés dans un rayon de @Curve.AoEHexRange@ hexagones.
descriptions.ko: @Curve.ShieldDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 보호막을 얻고 석화 상태가 됩니다. 보호막이 파괴되면 암흑 에너지 파동을 방출해 @Curve.AoEHexRange@칸 내 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it.

<Bright>Active:</> Restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and strike the target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> lorsqu'il meurt, Yorick invoque un Gardien des esprits avec @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% PV max, qui provoque immédiatement, forçant les ennemis à l'attaquer.

<Bright>Active :</> Yorick récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV et frappe la cible, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques.
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 사망 시 최대 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% 지닌 정령 주술사를 소환하고 즉시 도발하여 적이 자신을 공격하도록 합니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 회복하고 대상을 타격해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and splits, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to @Curve.NumSecondaryTargets@ nearby enemies.
descriptions.fr: Yunara effectue une ruée et lance un orbe sur sa cible actuelle, lui infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques avant de ricocher pour infliger @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques à @Curve.NumSecondaryTargets@ ennemis proches.
descriptions.ko: 돌진한 후 현재 대상에게 구체를 날립니다. 구체는 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입히고 나뉘어져 주변 적 @Curve.NumSecondaryTargets@명에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> Upon falling below @Curve.ManaHPThreshold*100@% max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.

<Bright>Active:</> Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% before dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD% physical damage in a large cone.
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> lorsque Sett passe sous @Curve.ManaHPThreshold*100@% de ses PV max pour la première fois à chaque combat, il gagne 100 mana.

<Bright>Active :</> Sett prépare un puissant coup de poing et récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% avant d'infliger @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques dans un large cône.
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 전투마다 처음으로 체력이 최대 체력 @Curve.ManaHPThreshold*100@% 아래로 떨어지면 마나를 100 얻습니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> 힘을 모아 강력한 펀치를 날려 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% 회복하고 큰 원뿔 범위에 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within @Curve.AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a @Curve.HexRadius@ hex radius, reduced by @Curve.HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip*100@% per hex away from the epicenter.
descriptions.fr: Ahri lance une bombe spirituelle à l'emplacement dans un rayon de @Curve.AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexagones ayant le plus d'ennemis autour. Elle inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques aux ennemis dans un rayon de @Curve.HexRadius@ hexagones, réduits de @Curve.HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip*100@% par hexagone qui les sépare de l'épicentre.
descriptions.ko: @Curve.AbilityCenterHexRange@칸 내 주변에 가장 적이 많은 위치에 영혼 폭탄을 날립니다. 영혼 폭탄은 반경 @Curve.HexRadius@칸 내 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 피해량은 중심으로부터 1칸 멀어질 때마다 @Curve.HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip*100@% 감소합니다.

descriptions.en:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @Curve.DamageFalloffPerEnemy*100@% per enemy hit (minimum @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@%). 

The arrow leaves a trail for @Curve.RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% + @Curve.MaxHealthDamagePerSecond*100@% max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @Curve.ChillPercent@% <Keyword>Slows</> them.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</>
descriptions.fr:
Ashe tire une flèche à travers la plus longue ligne d'ennemis, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques, réduits de @Curve.DamageFalloffPerEnemy*100@% par ennemi touché (total minimum : @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@%).

La flèche laisse derrière elle une traînée pendant @Curve.RiftDuration@ sec, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% + @Curve.MaxHealthDamagePerSecond*100@% des PV max sous forme de dégâts physiques par seconde aux ennemis à l'intérieur, et les <Keyword>ralentit</> de @Curve.ChillPercent@ %.

<Rules>Ralentissement : réduit la vitesse d'attaque.</>
descriptions.ko:
가장 적이 많은 일직선상에 화살을 발사해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 피해량은 적중한 적 하나당 @Curve.DamageFalloffPerEnemy*100@% 감소합니다. (최소 @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@%)

화살이 @Curve.RiftDuration@초 동안 궤적을 남겨 범위 내 적에게 매초 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%+최대 체력의 @Curve.MaxHealthDamagePerSecond*100@%만큼 물리 피해를 입히고 @Curve.ChillPercent@% <Keyword>둔화</>시킵니다.

<Rules>둔화: 공격 속도 감소</>

descriptions.en: Transform into a spider and gain @Curve.SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage and heal for @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%. Subsequent casts grant @Curve.DecayingAS.PercentMinusOne@% decaying Attack Speed for @Curve.ASBuffDuration@ seconds.
descriptions.fr: Elise se transforme en araignée et gagne @Curve.SpiderHealthBuff@ PV max. En forme d'araignée, ses attaques infligent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques bonus et lui rendent @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV. Les lancements suivants lui octroient @Curve.DecayingAS.PercentMinusOne@% de vitesse d'attaque décroissante pendant @Curve.ASBuffDuration@ sec.
descriptions.ko: 거미로 변신하고 최대 체력을 @Curve.SpiderHealthBuff@ 얻습니다. 거미 형태일 때 기본 공격 시 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 추가 마법 피해를 입히고 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 체력을 회복합니다. 이후 스킬 사용 시 @Curve.ASBuffDuration@초 동안 점차 감소하는 공격 속도를 @Curve.DecayingAS.PercentMinusOne@% 얻습니다.

descriptions.en: <Bright>Passive:</> Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage.
descriptions.fr: <Bright>Passive :</> chaque troisième attaque est remplacée par un tir dans la tête qui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques.
descriptions.ko: <Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 모든 3번째 기본 공격이 헤드샷으로 대체되어 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @Curve.Duration@ seconds. Poisons stack.
descriptions.fr: Cassiopeia empoisonne la cible et l'ennemi non empoisonné le plus proche, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques en @Curve.Duration@ sec. Le poison se cumule.
descriptions.ko: 대상을 중독시키고 가장 근처에 있는 중독되지 않은 적에게 @Curve.Duration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 중독은 중첩됩니다.

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> Gain @Curve.Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp.

<bright>Active:</> Fire a dark blast at @Curve.NumEnemiesCursed@ nearby enemies, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and cursing them for @Curve.SpellDuration@ seconds. Then, spawn a @Curve.HexRangeAOE@ Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% more damage per curse.
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> Morgana gagne @Curve.Omnivamp*100@% d'omnivampirisme.

<bright>Active :</> Morgana tire une décharge sombre sur les @Curve.NumEnemiesCursed@ ennemis les plus proches, leur infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques et les maudissant pendant @Curve.SpellDuration@ sec. Elle fait ensuite apparaître une zone de flétrissement de @Curve.HexRangeAOE@ hexagones pendant la même durée, qui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques par seconde. Les ennemis maudits subissent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts supplémentaires par malédiction.
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 모든 피해 흡혈을 @Curve.Omnivamp*100@% 얻습니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> 주변 적 @Curve.NumEnemiesCursed@명에게 암흑 파동을 발사해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히고 @Curve.SpellDuration@초 동안 저주를 겁니다. 이후 같은 지속시간 동안 @Curve.HexRangeAOE@칸 범위의 쇠약 지대를 생성해 매초 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 저주받은 적은 저주 하나당 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP%의 추가 피해를 입습니다.

descriptions.en: Gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @Curve.ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1.PercentMinusOne@% %i:scaleAP% decaying Attack Speed for @Curve.AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.
descriptions.fr: Rakan gagne un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV pendant @Curve.ShieldDuration@ sec. Il octroie ensuite à l'allié ayant infligé le plus de dégâts lors de ce combat @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1.PercentMinusOne@% %i:scaleAP% de vitesse d'attaque décroissante pendant @Curve.AttackSpeedDuration@ sec.
descriptions.ko: @Curve.ShieldDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 보호막을 얻습니다. 이후 이번 전투에서 가장 많은 피해를 입힌 아군에게 공격 속도를 @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1.PercentMinusOne@% %i:scaleAP% 부여합니다. 공격 속도는 @Curve.AttackSpeedDuration@초에 걸쳐 점차 사라집니다.

descriptions.en: Restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and send @Curve.NumEnemiesToFireAt@ butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Sleep for @Curve.SleepDuration@ seconds. If they take @Curve.DamageNeededToAwaken@ damage, they wake up and take an additional @Curve.WakeupDamage*100@% max Health magic damage.
descriptions.fr: Lillia récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV et envoie @Curve.NumEnemiesToFireAt@ papillons vers les ennemis proches. Les ennemis touchés subissent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques et sont endormis pendant @Curve.SleepDuration@ sec. S'ils subissent @Curve.DamageNeededToAwaken@ pts de dégâts, ils se réveillent et subissent des dégâts magiques bonus équivalents à @Curve.WakeupDamage*100@% de leurs PV max.
descriptions.ko: 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 회복하고 주변 적에게 나비 @Curve.NumEnemiesToFireAt@마리를 날려 보냅니다. 적중한 적은 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입고 @Curve.SleepDuration@초 동안 수면 상태가 됩니다. @Curve.DamageNeededToAwaken@의 피해를 입으면 잠에서 깨어나며 추가로 최대 체력의 @Curve.WakeupDamage*100@%만큼 마법 피해를 입습니다.

descriptions.en: Restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health over @Curve.Duration@ seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% magic damage.
descriptions.fr: Kobuko récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% PV en @Curve.Duration@ sec. Sa prochaine attaque est remplacée par un coup puissant qui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques.
descriptions.ko: @Curve.Duration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%의 체력을 회복합니다. 다음 기본 공격이 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히는 강타로 대체됩니다.

descriptions.en:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the @Curve.NumEnemiesHit@ nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the target.

Each cast has a @Curve.PercentChanceOfForage*100@% chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects.

<bright>Red:</> @Curve.RedRerolls@ Reroll  <Rules>(Reds Foraged: </>@TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@<Rules>)</>
<bright>Green:</> @Curve.GreenHealth@ Tactician Health <Rules>(Greens Foraged:</> @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</>
<bright>Yellow:</> @Curve.YellowXP@ XP <Rules>(Yellows Foraged:</> @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</>
descriptions.fr:
Teemo lance 2 grappes de champignons qui infligent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques aux @Curve.NumEnemiesHit@ ennemis les plus proches. Il lance ensuite un champignon géant qui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques à sa cible.

À chaque lancement, Teemo a @Curve.PercentChanceOfForage*100@% de chances de trouver un champignon octroyant un effet bonus.

<bright>Rouge :</> @Curve.RedRerolls@ relance <Rules>(Champignons rouges trouvés : </>@TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@<Rules>)</>
<bright>Vert :</> @Curve.GreenHealth@ PV de Tacticien <Rules>(Champignons verts trouvés :</> @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</>
<bright>Jaune :</> @Curve.YellowXP@ XP <Rules>(Champignons jaunes trouvés :</> @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</>
descriptions.ko:
가장 가까운 적 @Curve.NumEnemiesHit@명에게 버섯 다발 2개를 던져 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 이후 거대 버섯을 던져 대상에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

스킬을 사용할 때마다 @Curve.PercentChanceOfForage*100@% 확률로 추가 버섯을 채집하고 추가 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다.

<bright>빨간색:</> 새로고침 @Curve.RedRerolls@회 <Rules>(빨간색 채집: </>@TFTSpellAttributes.Stack@<Rules>)</>
<bright>초록색:</> 전략가 체력 @Curve.GreenHealth@ <Rules>(초록색 채집:</> @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</>
<bright>노란색:</> 경험치 @Curve.YellowXP@ <Rules>(노란색 채집:</> @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</>

descriptions.en:
Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For @Curve.Duration@ seconds, gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield and @Curve.ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist.

When the Shield breaks, deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% physical damage to enemies in @Curve.DamageHexRange@ Hexes.
descriptions.fr:
Rammus provoque ses adversaires pour les forcer à l'attaquer. Pendant @Curve.Duration@ sec, il gagne un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV, ainsi que @Curve.ArmorMR@ d'armure et de résistance magique.

Lorsque le bouclier se brise, il inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% pts de dégâts physiques aux ennemis dans un rayon de @Curve.DamageHexRange@ hexagones.
descriptions.ko:
도발하여 적이 이 챔피언을 공격하도록 합니다. @Curve.Duration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 보호막과 방어력 및 마법 저항력을 @Curve.ArmorMR@ 얻습니다.

보호막이 파괴되면, @Curve.DamageHexRange@칸 내 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> Gain @Curve.RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @Curve.RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack. 

<Bright>Active:</> Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within @Curve.TransformSearchRadius@ hexes. Then, deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies within @Curve.TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, and Stun them for @Curve.StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.

<Bright>Grab n' Throw:</> Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them and @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> Gnar gagne @Curve.RagePerSecond@ de rage par seconde et @Curve.RagePerAttack@ de rage par attaque.

<Bright>Active :</> Gnar se transforme en Méga Gnar et bondit vers le plus grand groupe d'ennemis dans un rayon de @Curve.TransformSearchRadius@ hexagones. Il inflige ensuite @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques aux ennemis situés dans un rayon de @Curve.TransformHexRadius@ hexagones, réduit leur armure et leur résistance magique de @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, et les étourdit pendant @Curve.StunDuration@ sec. Méga Gnar gagne @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ PV et remplace sa compétence par Lancement primitif.

<Bright>Lancement primitif :</> Gnar lance sa cible sur l'ennemi le plus éloigné, leur infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques et @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques aux ennemis traversés. S'il ne reste qu'un seul ennemi, il le balance hors du champ de bataille.
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 분노를 매초 @Curve.RagePerSecond@, 기본 공격당 @Curve.RagePerAttack@ 얻습니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> 메가 나르로 변신하고 @Curve.TransformSearchRadius@칸 내 가장 큰 적 무리로 도약합니다. 이후 @Curve.TransformHexRadius@칸 내 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 또한 @Curve.StunDuration@초 동안 대상의 방어력 및 마법 저항력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 감소시키고 기절시킵니다. 메가 나르가 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ 얻고 스킬이 집어 던지기로 변경됩니다.

<Bright>집어 던지기:</> 대상을 가장 멀리 있는 적에게 던져 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입히고, 관통하는 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 적이 1명만 남았다면, 대신 해당 적을 전장 밖으로 던져버립니다.

descriptions.en:
Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts @Curve.Duration@ seconds. While active, gain infinite range and @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage + @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% for each attack while casting.

<Rules>If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.</>
descriptions.fr:
Tristana pose une charge explosive sur sa cible pendant @Curve.Duration@ sec. Tant que la charge est active, elle bénéficie d'une portée infinie et gagne @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% de vitesse d'attaque. À la fin du délai, la charge explose et inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques + @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% pour chaque attaque lancée pendant le délai répartis entre tous les ennemis se trouvant dans un rayon de 2 hexagones.

<Rules>Si un ennemi portant une charge explosive meurt, celle-ci se fixe sur la nouvelle cible de Tristana.</>
descriptions.ko:
대상에게 @Curve.Duration@초 동안 지속되는 폭발 화약을 부착합니다. 지속시간 동안 사거리 제한이 없어지고 공격 속도를 @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% 얻습니다. 지속시간이 끝나면 화약이 폭발해 2칸 내 모든 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해+스킬 사용 중 기본 공격마다 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%에 해당하는 피해를 나누어 입힙니다.

<Rules>폭발 화약이 부착된 적이 사망하면 트리스타나의 새로운 대상에게 화약이 부착됩니다.</>

descriptions.en: Throw a large crossblade that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to the current target and bounces @Curve.NumBounces@ times between nearby enemies, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @Curve.BonusKillBounces@ additional times.
descriptions.fr: Sivir lance une grosse lame en croix qui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques à sa cible actuelle et rebondit @Curve.NumBounces@ fois sur les ennemis proches, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques à chaque rebond. Si la lame élimine un ennemi, elle rebondit @Curve.BonusKillBounces@ fois de plus.
descriptions.ko: 거대한 십자날을 던져 현재 대상에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 십자날은 주변 적에게 @Curve.NumBounces@번 튕기며 튕길 때마다 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 적을 처치하면 @Curve.BonusKillBounces@번 더 튕깁니다.

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> On attack, restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health.

<bright>Active:</> Unleash a primal roar, restoring @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Then gain @Curve.SpellAS.PercentMinusOne@% Attack Speed, @Curve.SpellDurability*100@% Durability, and is Unstoppable for @Curve.SpellDuration@ seconds.
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> lors qu'elle attaque, Vi récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% PV.

<bright>Active :</> Vi laisse échapper un rugissement primal pour récupérer @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% PV. Puis, elle gagne @Curve.SpellAS.PercentMinusOne@% de vitesse d'attaque, @Curve.SpellDurability*100@% de durabilité, et elle est inarrêtable pendant @Curve.SpellDuration@ sec.
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 기본 공격 시 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% 회복합니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> 원시의 포효를 내질러 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% 회복합니다. 이후 @Curve.SpellDuration@초 동안 공격 속도를 @Curve.SpellAS.PercentMinusOne@%, 내구력을 @Curve.SpellDurability*100@% 얻고 저지 불가 상태가 됩니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Adaptor </>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. If the target is <keyword>Burning</>, deal an additional @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% damage.

<dim>Adaptor </>%i:scaleAP%</><dim>: If the Ability kills, cast it again.</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Adaptateur </>%i:scaleAD%<Bright> :</> Akali lance une salve de kunai sur la cible, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques. Si la cible <keyword>brûle</>, elle inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts bonus.

<dim>Adaptateur </>%i:scaleAP%</><dim> : si la compétence élimine la cible, elle la lance de nouveau.</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>적응가 </>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</> 대상에게 단검 다발을 던져 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 대상이 <keyword>화상</> 상태일 경우 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

<dim>적응가 </>%i:scaleAP%</><dim>: 이 스킬로 적을 처치하면 다시 사용합니다.</>

descriptions.en: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% for each enemy it passes through (minimum @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@%).
descriptions.fr: Varus bande son arc, puis tire une flèche sur les ennemis les plus nombreux alignés avec la cible. La flèche inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques aux ennemis touchés, réduits de @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% pour chaque ennemi traversé (jusqu'à un minimum de @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@% pts de dégâts).
descriptions.ko: 힘을 모은 후 대상을 포함해 적이 가장 많은 일직선 방향으로 화살을 발사해 적중한 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 관통한 적 하나당 피해량이 @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% 감소합니다. (최소 @Curve.MinDamagePercent*100@%)

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> Every second, restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Health and deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @Curve.PassiveHexRadius@ hex.

<Bright>Active:</> Deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @Curve.BigHexRadius@ hexes and Stun them for @Curve.StunDuration@ seconds, increased to @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ seconds if the target is <Keyword>Burning</>.

<Rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> chaque seconde, Amumu récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% PV et inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques aux ennemis dans un rayon de @Curve.PassiveHexRadius@ hexagone.

<Bright>Active :</> Amumu inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques aux ennemis dans un rayon de @Curve.BigHexRadius@ hexagones et les étourdit pendant @Curve.StunDuration@ sec, augmenté à @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ sec si la cible <Keyword>brûle</>.

<Rules>Brûlure : inflige des dégâts bruts équivalents à un pourcentage des PV max de la cible chaque seconde.</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 매초 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% 의 체력을 회복하고 @Curve.PassiveHexRadius@ 칸 내의 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> @Curve.BigHexRadius@ 칸 내의 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% 의 마법 피해를 입히고 @Curve.StunDuration@ 초 동안 기절시킵니다. 대상이 <Keyword>불태우기</> 상태인 경우 기절 지속시간이 @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ 초로 증가합니다.

<Rules>불태우기: 매초 대상 최대 체력의 일부에 해당하는 고정 피해를 입힙니다.</>

descriptions.en:
Charge up, gaining @Curve.APPerBurningEnemy*100@% Ability Power per <Keyword>Burning</> enemy. Then, gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @Curve.ShieldDuration@ seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each. 

After rushing, unleash a @Curve.FirestormHexRadius@ Hex firestorm that deals a total of @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies hit over @Curve.FirestormDuration@ seconds.
descriptions.fr:
Kennen se charge et gagne @Curve.APPerBurningEnemy*100@% de puissance par ennemi qui <Keyword>brûle</>. Puis, il gagne un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV pendant @Curve.ShieldDuration@ sec et fonce à travers un groupe d'ennemis à proximité, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques à chacun.

Après la ruée, il déclenche une tempête de feu de @Curve.FirestormHexRadius@ hexagones qui inflige un total de @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques répartis entre tous les ennemis touchés pendant @Curve.FirestormDuration@ sec.
descriptions.ko:
힘을 모으며 <Keyword>화상</> 상태인 적 하나당 주문력을 @Curve.APPerBurningEnemy*100@% 얻습니다. 이후 @Curve.ShieldDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 보호막을 얻고 주변 적 무리를 통과해 돌진하며 각각 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

돌진한 후 @Curve.FirestormHexRadius@칸 범위의 불꽃 폭풍을 내보내 적중한 모든 적에게 @Curve.FirestormDuration@초 동안 총 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 나누어 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
Equip Severum and swipe the target @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAS% times over @Curve.Duration@ seconds, each dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. 

After the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.
descriptions.fr:
Aphelios équipe Severum et balaie la cible @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAS% fois en @Curve.Duration@ sec, chaque coup infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques.

Après la fin de l'assaut, il tire une décharge qui inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques répartis entre tous les ennemis dans un rayon de 2 hexagones.
descriptions.ko:
절단검을 장착하고 @Curve.Duration@초 동안 대상을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAS%번 휩쓸어 각각 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

맹공이 끝나면 파동을 발사해 반경 2칸 내 모든 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 나누어 입힙니다.

descriptions.en: Gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ shield for @Curve.ShieldDuration@ seconds and send out @Curve.NumOrbs@ moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
descriptions.fr: Diana gagne un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ PV pendant @Curve.ShieldDuration@ sec et envoie @Curve.NumOrbs@ orbes de clair de lune vers les ennemis se trouvant dans un rayon de 2 hexagones. Chaque orbe inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques.
descriptions.ko: @Curve.ShieldDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@의 보호막을 얻고 2칸 내 적에게 달빛 구체 @Curve.NumOrbs@개를 나누어 보내 각각 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
Rain @Curve.NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @Curve.NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage each.

If the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies.
descriptions.fr:
Alune fait pleuvoir @Curve.NumMoonshards@ éclats de lune répartis entre les @Curve.NumEnemies@ ennemis les plus proches, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques chacun.

Si la lune est pleine, elle s'écrase sur le plateau, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques répartis entre tous les ennemis.
descriptions.ko:
가장 가까운 적 @Curve.NumEnemies@명에게 달조각 @Curve.NumMoonshards@개를 나누어 떨어뜨려 각각 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

보름달일 경우, 대신 전장에 달을 떨어뜨려 모든 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 나누어 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> Start combat with @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over @Curve.DecayDuration@ seconds.

<Bright>Active:</> Bash the current target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor% magic damage and Stunning them for @Curve.StunDuration@ seconds.
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> Leona commence le combat avec @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% d'armure et de résistance magique bonus, qui diminuent en @Curve.DecayDuration@ sec.

<Bright>Active :</> Leona frappe la cible actuelle, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor% pts de dégâts magiques et l'étourdit pendant @Curve.StunDuration@ sec.
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> @Curve.DecayDuration@초에 걸쳐 서서히 감소하는 추가 방어력 및 마법 저항력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 얻은 상태로 전투를 시작합니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> 현재 대상을 강타해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor%의 마법 피해를 입히고 @Curve.StunDuration@초 동안 기절시킵니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 

<Bright>1st Ascension:</> Attacks deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage.
<Bright>2nd Ascension:</> Attacks @Curve.ShredLevel@% <Keyword>Shred</> enemies hit for @Curve.ShredDuration@ seconds. 
<Bright>3rd Ascension:</> Attacks fire waves, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all other units hit.
<Bright>4th Ascension:</> Gain infinite range. Every @Curve.NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@rd wave is much larger.

<Rules>Shred: Reduce Magic Resist</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> Kayle évolue selon son niveau d'étoile, ce qui lui confère des bonus cumulables.

<Bright>1re ascension :</> ses attaques infligent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques bonus.
<Bright>2e ascension :</> ses attaques appliquent @Curve.ShredLevel@ % de <Keyword>scission magique</> aux ennemis touchés pendant @Curve.ShredDuration@ sec.
<Bright>3e ascension :</> ses attaques lancent des vagues infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques à toutes les autres unités touchées.
<Bright>4e ascension :</> elle gagne une portée infinie. Chaque @Curve.NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@e vague est bien plus grande.

<Rules>Scission magique : réduit la résistance magique.</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 케일이 별 레벨에 따라 승천하여, 중첩되는 추가 효과를 얻습니다.

<Bright>1차 승천:</> 기본 공격 시 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 추가 마법 피해를 입힙니다.
<Bright>2차 승천:</> 기본 공격 시 적중한 적에게 @Curve.ShredDuration@초 동안 @Curve.ShredLevel@% <Keyword>파쇄</>를 적용합니다.
<Bright>3차 승천:</> 기본 공격 시 파동을 발사해 적중한 다른 모든 유닛에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.
<Bright>4차 승천:</> 사거리 제한이 없어집니다. @Curve.NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@번째 파동마다 매우 큰 파동을 발사합니다.

<Rules>파쇄: 마법 저항력 감소</>

descriptions.en: Gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Shield for @Curve.ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and strike in a line, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies hit.
descriptions.fr: Sejuani gagne un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% PV pendant @Curve.ShieldDuration@ sec. Elle effectue ensuite une attaque en cône, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques, avant de frapper en ligne droite pour infliger @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques aux ennemis touchés.
descriptions.ko: @Curve.ShieldDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%의 보호막을 얻습니다. 이후 원뿔 범위를 쪼개 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히고 일직선상을 타격하여 적중한 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en: Leap to the farthest enemy within @Curve.LeapRangeHexes@ Hexes, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage instead and gain @Curve.IsolateManaGrant@ mana.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
descriptions.fr: Kha'Zix bondit sur l'ennemi le plus éloigné dans un rayon de @Curve.LeapRangeHexes@ hexagones, lui infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques. Si sa cible n'a pas d'allié adjacent, il inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques à la place et gagne @Curve.IsolateManaGrant@ pts de mana.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
descriptions.ko: @Curve.LeapRangeHexes@칸 내 가장 멀리 있는 적에게 도약해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 대상과 인접한 아군이 없을 경우 대신 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히고 마나를 @Curve.IsolateManaGrant@ 얻습니다.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}

descriptions.en: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within @Curve.JumpHexRange@ hexes and stab them, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. Then heal for @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, increased to up to @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% based on their missing Health.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
descriptions.fr: Rengar bondit sur l'ennemi ayant le plus faible pourcentage de PV dans un rayon de @Curve.JumpHexRange@ hexagones et le poignarde, lui infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques. Puis, il récupère @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV, augmentés à @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% selon ses PV manquants.
descriptions.ko: @Curve.JumpHexRange@칸 내 체력 비율이 가장 낮은 적에게 도약하고 찔러 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 이후 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 체력을 회복합니다. 잃은 체력에 따라 체력 회복량이 최대 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%까지 증가합니다.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Adaptor</> %i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</> Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. Enemies below @Curve.ADBonusDamageThreshold*100@% max Health take @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage instead.

<dim>Adaptor</>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: Damages enemies over time.</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Adaptateur</> %i:scaleAD%<Bright> :</> Kog'Maw crache de l'acide sur sa cible et l'autre ennemi le plus proche, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques. Les ennemis ayant moins de @Curve.ADBonusDamageThreshold*100@% PV max subissent @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques à la place.

<dim>Adaptateur</> %i:scaleAP%<dim> : Kog'Maw inflige des dégâts sur la durée aux ennemis.</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>적응가</> %i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</> 대상 및 가장 가까운 다른 적에게 산성을 뿌려 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 최대 체력 @Curve.ADBonusDamageThreshold*100@% 아래인 적은 대신 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입습니다.

<dim>적응가</>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: 적에게 지속 피해를 입힙니다.</>

descriptions.en: Spawn @Curve.NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy @Curve.ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ times. Each attack deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
descriptions.fr: Zyra invoque @Curve.NumPlantsToSpawn@ plantes qui attaquent @Curve.ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ fois l'ennemi le plus proche. Chaque attaque inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques.
descriptions.ko: 가장 가까운 적을 @Curve.ThornSpitterNumAttacks@회 공격하는 식물 @Curve.NumPlantsToSpawn@개를 전장 곳곳에 생성합니다. 공격할 때마다 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en: Reduce the Magic Resist of the @Curve.NumTargets@ nearest enemies by @Curve.MRReduction@. Then drain life from them over @Curve.CastDuration@ seconds, healing for @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each over the duration.
descriptions.fr: Fiddlesticks réduit la résistance magique des @Curve.NumTargets@ ennemis les plus proches de @Curve.MRReduction@. Puis il draine leur vie pendant @Curve.CastDuration@ sec, se soignant de @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV et infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques à chacun pendant cette durée.
descriptions.ko: 가장 가까운 적 @Curve.NumTargets@명의 마법 저항력을 @Curve.MRReduction@만큼 감소시킵니다. 그 후 @Curve.CastDuration@ 초에 걸쳐 적의 생명력을 흡수하여 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 의 체력을 회복하고 각각 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down @Curve.NumAdditionalStars@ additional stars that each deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
descriptions.fr: Soraka fait tomber une étoile sur sa cible actuelle, lui infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques. Si une étoile est déjà tombée sur elle, elle fait tomber @Curve.NumAdditionalStars@ étoiles supplémentaires, chacune infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques.
descriptions.ko: 현재 대상에게 별을 떨어뜨려 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 이전에 별이 떨어졌다면, 추가 별 @Curve.NumAdditionalStars@개를 떨어뜨려 각각 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below @Curve.PassivePercentHealthThreshold*100@% Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Shield to allies within @Curve.PassiveHexRadius@ Hexes for @Curve.PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds.

<Bright>Active:</> Restore @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Taric and his paired ally deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage on their next @Curve.NumAttacks@ attacks.
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> la première fois que Taric ou son allié lié tombe en dessous de @Curve.PassivePercentHealthThreshold*100@% PV, une énergie émeraude est libérée depuis les deux, octroyant un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% PV aux alliés situés dans un rayon de @Curve.PassiveHexRadius@ hexagones pendant @Curve.PassiveShieldDuration@ sec.

<Bright>Active :</> Taric restaure @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% PV. Taric et son allié lié infligent @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques bonus lors de leurs @Curve.NumAttacks@ prochaines attaques.
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 타릭 또는 타릭과 짝을 이룬 아군 체력이 처음 @Curve.PassivePercentHealthThreshold*100@% 아래로 떨어지면 타릭과 해당 아군이 에메랄드 에너지를 방출해 @Curve.PassiveHexRadius@칸 내 아군에게 @Curve.PassiveShieldDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%의 보호막을 부여합니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 회복합니다. 타릭 및 타릭과 짝을 이룬 아군이 다음 @Curve.NumAttacks@번의 기본 공격 시 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 추가 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> Shields from this Ability can critically strike with <Keyword>Precision</>. 

<bright>Active:</> Grant @Curve.NumAlliesToShield@ allies @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA% Shield and @Curve.DamageAmpAmount*100@% Damage Amp for @Curve.ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @Curve.CastThreshold@ times, also grant @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% stacking Attack Speed to targets.
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> les boucliers de cette compétence peuvent infliger un coup critique avec <Keyword>Précision</>.

<bright>Active :</> Ivern confère à @Curve.NumAlliesToShield@ alliés un bouclier de @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA% PV et @Curve.DamageAmpAmount*100@% d'amplification des dégâts pendant @Curve.ShieldDuration@ sec. Puis il inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques aux ennemis qui leur sont adjacents. Après @Curve.CastThreshold@ activations, il octroie également @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% de vitesse d'attaque cumulable aux cibles.
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 이 스킬로 생성되는 보호막은 <Keyword>정밀</>에 의해 치명타가 적용될 수 있습니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> 아군 @Curve.NumAlliesToShield@명에게 @Curve.ShieldDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA%의 보호막을 씌우고 피해 증폭을 @Curve.DamageAmpAmount*100@% 부여합니다. 이후 대상과 인접한 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 스킬을 @Curve.CastThreshold@번 사용하면 추가로 중첩되는 공격 속도를 @Curve.AttackSpeed.PercentMinusOne@% 부여합니다.

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% mana. 

<bright>Active:</> Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, reduced by @Curve.DamageReductionPerUnit*100@% for each enemy hit.
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> au lancement, tous les alliés partageant un type avec Lux gagnent @TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de mana.

<bright>Active :</> Lux tire un laser en direction du plus grand groupe d'ennemis, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques, réduits de @Curve.DamageReductionPerUnit*100@% pour chaque ennemi touché.
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 스킬 사용 시, 럭스와 특성을 공유하는 모든 아군이 마나를 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% 얻습니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> 가장 큰 적 무리를 향해 레이저를 발사해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 적중한 적 하나당 피해가 @Curve.DamageReductionPerUnit*100@% 감소합니다.
