descriptions.en: Roar, restoring @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%. Then slam the current target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @Curve.StunDuration@ seconds.
descriptions.fr: Alistar rugit, ce qui lui rend @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% PV, supprime les entraves et soigne les deux alliés ayant le plus faible pourcentage de PV de @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%. Puis il percute sa cible actuelle, lui infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques et l'étourdissant pendant @Curve.StunDuration@ sec.
descriptions.ko: 포효하며 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% 회복하고 모든 방해 효과를 정화합니다. 또한 체력 비율이 가장 낮은 아군 2명의 체력을 @TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% 회복시킵니다. 이후 현재 대상을 강타해 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히고 @Curve.StunDuration@초 동안 기절시킵니다.

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage over @Curve.BleedDuration@ seconds. Every attack has a @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% chance to deal @Curve.SpinningAxeDamageRatio.PercentMinusOne@% bonus physical damage and apply @Curve.SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ bleeds instead. 

<bright>Active:</> Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies hit.
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> Draven attaque des ennemis aléatoires à portée et les fait saigner, leur infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques en @Curve.BleedDuration@ sec. Chaque attaque a @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% chances d'infliger @Curve.SpinningAxeDamageRatio.PercentMinusOne@% pts de dégâts physiques bonus et d'appliquer @Curve.SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ effets de saignement à la place.

<bright>Active :</> Draven lance deux haches géantes en direction de l'ennemi ayant le plus d'effets de saignement. Draven inflige @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% pts de dégâts physiques à tous les ennemis touchés et consomme leur saignement, infligeant instantanément les dégâts restants.
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 기본 공격이 사거리 내 무작위 적을 대상으로 지정하고 출혈을 적용해 @Curve.BleedDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 기본 공격마다 @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% 확률로 대신 @Curve.SpinningAxeDamageRatio.PercentMinusOne@%의 추가 물리 피해를 입히고 @Curve.SpinningAxeBleedStacks@의 출혈을 적용합니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> 출혈 중첩이 가장 많은 적을 향해 거대한 도끼 두 개를 던집니다. 적중한 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입히고 대상의 출혈 효과를 소모해 즉시 남은 피해량을 입힙니다. 이후 도끼가 돌아오면서 적중한 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> Attacks deal @Curve.AttackAoERatio*100@% damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

<Bright>Active:</> Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for @Curve.StunDuration@ seconds, gain @Curve.Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, and Ignite them for @Curve.IgniteDuration@ seconds.  Ignited enemies take @Curve.IgniteMaxHealthDamage*100@% max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

<Bright>Flame Breath:</>  Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage, reduced by @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% for each enemy it passes through (minimum @Curve.MinimumDamageThreshold*100@%.) Ignite those enemies for @Curve.IgniteDuration@ seconds.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Elder Dragon Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Damaging an enemy below @Curve.TraitExecuteThreshold*100@% Health executes them.</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> les attaques infligent @Curve.AttackAoERatio*100@% des dégâts aux ennemis adjacents à la cible.

<Bright>Active :</> le Dragon ancestral devient invulnérable et s'envole dans les airs. À son retour, il étourdit tous les ennemis pendant @Curve.StunDuration@ sec, les embrase pendant @Curve.IgniteDuration@ sec et gagne @Curve.Omnivamp*100@% d'omnivampirisme.  Les ennemis embrasés subissent des dégâts physiques équivalents à @Curve.IgniteMaxHealthDamage*100@% de leurs PV max par seconde. Cette compétence devient Souffle de flammes et est lancée immédiatement.

<Bright>Souffle de flammes :</> le Dragon ancestral souffle du feu sur le plus grand nombre d'ennemis alignés derrière la cible, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts physiques, moins @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% pour chaque ennemi traversé (Inflige au minimum @Curve.MinimumDamageThreshold*100@% des dégâts). Le Dragon ancestral embrase ces ennemis pendant @Curve.IgniteDuration@ sec.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff du Dragon ancestral :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">infliger des dégâts à un ennemi ayant moins de @Curve.TraitExecuteThreshold*100@% de ses PV l'exécute.</>
descriptions.ko:
<Bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 기본 공격 시 대상과 인접한 적에게 @Curve.AttackAoERatio*100@%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

<Bright>사용 시:</> 무적 상태가 되어 공중으로 날아오릅니다. 귀환 시 모든 적을 @Curve.StunDuration@초 동안 기절시킵니다. 또한 @Curve.IgniteDuration@초 동안 모든 피해 흡혈을 @Curve.Omnivamp*100@% 얻고 적에게 점화를 적용합니다.  점화 상태인 적은 매초 최대 체력의 @Curve.IgniteMaxHealthDamage*100@%만큼 물리 피해를 입습니다. 이 스킬이 화염 숨결로 대체되고 즉시 사용합니다.

<Bright>화염 숨결:</> 적이 가장 많은 일직선 방향에 불을 내뿜어 @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 관통한 적 하나당 피해량이 @Curve.DamageReductionPerHit*100@% 감소합니다. (최소 @Curve.MinimumDamageThreshold*100@%) 적중한 적에게 @Curve.IgniteDuration@초 동안 점화를 적용합니다.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">장로 드래곤 버프:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">체력이 @Curve.TraitExecuteThreshold*100@% 아래인 적에게 피해를 입히면 처형합니다.</>

descriptions.en:
Tether the current target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @Curve.TetherDuration@ seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all enemies in a @Curve.AoEHexRange@ Hex radius and @Curve.SlowPercent@% <keyword>Slowing</> them for @Curve.SlowDuration@ seconds.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</>
descriptions.fr:
Karma se lie à sa cible actuelle, lui infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques en @Curve.TetherDuration@ sec. Elle libère ensuite une explosion autour d'elle, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques à tous les ennemis dans un rayon de @Curve.AoEHexRange@ hexagone et leur appliquant @Curve.SlowPercent@ % de <keyword>ralentissement</> pendant @Curve.SlowDuration@ sec.

<Rules>Ralentissement : réduit la vitesse d'attaque.</>
descriptions.ko:
현재 대상을 연결해 @Curve.TetherDuration@초 동안 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 이후 주변에 힘을 폭발시켜 반경 @Curve.AoEHexRange@칸 이내 모든 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히고 @Curve.SlowDuration@초 동안 @Curve.SlowPercent@% <keyword>둔화</>를 적용합니다.

<Rules>둔화: 공격 속도 감소</>

descriptions.en:
<bright>Passive:</> After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a @Curve.PercentChanceToPrint*100@% chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by @Curve.PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus*100@% per takedown.

<bright>Active:</> Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% to adjacent enemies.
descriptions.fr:
<bright>Passive :</> après un combat contre un joueur, votre LeBlanc la plus forte a @Curve.PercentChanceToPrint*100@% de chances de créer une copie d'un allié sur votre plateau, augmenté de @Curve.PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus*100@% par élimination.

<bright>Active :</> LeBlanc lance une image miroir sur la cible actuelle, infligeant @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% pts de dégâts magiques et @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% aux ennemis adjacents.
descriptions.ko:
<bright>기본 지속 효과:</> 플레이어 대상 전투 후, 가장 강한 아군 르블랑이 @Curve.PercentChanceToPrint*100@% 확률로 전장에 있는 아군의 복사본 1명을 생성합니다. 이 확률은 처치 관여마다 @Curve.PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus*100@% 증가합니다.

<bright>사용 시:</> 현재 대상에게 거울 환영을 보내 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 마법 피해를 입히고 인접한 적에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en:
<Bright>Passive:</> Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed.

<Bright>Adaptor </>%i:scaleAD%: Double Strikes grant @TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% stacking Attack Speed.

<dim>Adaptor </>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.</>
descriptions.fr:
<Bright>Passive :</> chaque troisième attaque est un Coup double. En cas d'élimination, Maître Yi gagne un important bonus de vitesse de déplacement.

descriptions.ko:

descriptions.en: Grant @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield to Shen and @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% Shield to a nearby damaged ally for @Curve.MagicShieldDuration@ seconds. descriptions.ko: @Curve.MagicShieldDuration@초 동안 쉔에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 보호막을, 피해를 입은 주변 아군에게 @TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%의 보호막을 부여합니다. 두 유닛 모두 다음 기본 공격 @Curve.NumAttacksBuff@회 동안 공격 속도를 @Curve.AttackSpeedBuff*100@% 얻고 @TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%의 추가 마법 피해를 입힙니다.

descriptions.en: Bite the current target, dealing @TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage and healing for @TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1*100@% %i:scaleAP% of the damage dealt. <bright>햇빛 추가 효과:</> 배치한 3성 챔피언 한 종류당 @Curve.SolarBonusDamagePer3StarRadio*100@%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Buff orange :</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">infliger des dégâts physiques réduit l'armure de l'ennemi de </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim">@Curve.ArmorReduc@</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">.</>
